name: Connection saturation gauge
description: Semicircular gauge showing active backends against max_connections. Bind 'backends' to 'postgresql.backends' (sum or single DB) and 'max' to 'postgresql.connection.max'. Color zones at 50% / 80% paint a saturation profile under the dark fill arc.

spec.template:
Active {{ format backends.value 'none' 0 }}
Limit {{ format max.value 'none' 0 }}
spec.styles: .csg { display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100%; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem 0.85rem; gap: 0.4rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .csg svg { flex: 1; min-height: 0; max-height: 12rem; max-width: 100%; color: var(--color-graphite-500); } .csg svg .track    { stroke: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-graphite-500) 13%, transparent); } .csg svg .zone-ok   { stroke: var(--color-sage-500);   opacity: 0.32; } .csg svg .zone-warn { stroke: var(--color-amber-500);  opacity: 0.32; } .csg svg .zone-bad  { stroke: var(--color-rust-500);   opacity: 0.32; } .csg svg .fill      { stroke: var(--color-graphite-700); transition: stroke-dasharray 600ms ease-out; } .csg svg .pct  { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 600; fill: var(--color-graphite-700); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .csg svg .sub  { font-size: 0.55rem; fill: var(--color-graphite-500); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; } .csg .legend { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.2rem; padding-top: 0.1rem; } .csg .legend .cell { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.05rem; } .csg .legend .k { font-size: 0.62rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--color-graphite-500); } .csg .legend strong { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; } .csg .legend .sep { width: 1px; height: 1.5rem; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-graphite-500) 18%, transparent); }

dataBindings.name: backends
dataBindings.description: postgresql.backends — active backend processes (one DB or summed)
